This is honestly the best advice I can give anyone. It's what I did to rebuild my life after everything fell apart.

  1. Save up some $$ and troll Craigslist for old RVs (I spent $1200, just make sure it has good tires)

  2. Drive the RV to someplace warm near a big city (near opportunity, but away from high rent)

  3. Find a park that allows long-term residency (not glamorous, but some of these places have pools and hot tubs)

  4. Start minimum-waging it and enjoy some blissful freedom. (in an rv park, minimum wage can not only pay all your expenses, but you'll have money left for beer at the end of the week!)
